messages.subject: PNCGRM and FNCGRM
parts:
Dear Phil,

Do you have function available for the Partially Non-Compensatory Graded Response Model (PNCGRM) and Fully Non-Compensatory Graded Response Model (FNCGRM) from your 2020 paper "Partially and Fully Noncompensatory Response Models for Dichotomous and Polytomous Items"? I’m currently working with these models, so I’d greatly appreciate having them added to the package. Thanks a lot!

Best,
Yiqing
